sources.description: 中新网河北张家口9月25日电 (记者 阮煜琳)国际电力碳排放核算规则交流会日前在河北崇礼举办。清华大学能源环境经济研究所所长张希良在会上表示，目前，中国碳市场已经纳入发电、钢铁、水泥、铝冶炼四个行业，到2030年以前，全国碳市场将进一步扩大覆盖范围，还将纳入化工、石化等行业。届时，中国碳市场覆盖二氧化碳排放量，将占全国碳排放总量的75%以上。

sources.description: Updates from the first of two games in Queensland Kick-off time in Townsville is 8pm AEST Any thoughts? Get in touch with an email Socceroos head coach Tony Popovic continues to show he is prepared to make big selection calls with captain Maty Ryan axed from the squad for these two friendlies against Brazil. “We know what Maty Ryan is to Australian football,” Popovic said. “A player that has a distinguished career – continues to have one – over 100 caps. But we’d like to have a look at another keeper.” A legacy of more World Cup titles than any other nation demands respect, as does the aura of a shirt worn by the likes of Pelé, Socrates, Roberto Carlos, Ronaldinho, Ronaldo and Neymar. Vinícius, Raphinha, Marquinhos et al are global superstars, and the cultural cachet of joga bonito still permeates. So too are the good vibes, good people and goodwill that accompany them; a Brazilian supporter with a prop World Cup trophy in hand was among those navigating the connection to Townsville from Brisbane airport on Thursday morning. These fixtures, followed by a game against India on 3 October, are going to prove lucrative for the South Americans too. They’ll even be taking the field in Queensland as the official “home” side. Which brings us to football. And to start, if Brazil are after a genuine Australian football experience they will get one at Lang Park in Brisbane next Tuesday, when they play on a surface only four days after the Dolphins v Roosters preliminary final. But coming off another World Cup failure, Brazil have also landed at an inflection point. Or perhaps more accurately, the latest inflection point, as the nation conducts a new round of soul-searching over an increasingly diminishing place among football’s elite. Continue reading...

sources.title: “十五五”期间全国碳市场覆盖范围将进一步扩大
sources.description: 中新网河北张家口9月25日电 (记者 阮煜琳)国际电力碳排放核算规则交流会日前在河北崇礼举办。清华大学能源环境经济研究所所长张希良在会上表示，目前，中国碳市场已经纳入发电、钢铁、水泥、铝冶炼四个行业，到2030年以前，全国碳市场将进一步扩大覆盖范围，还将纳入化工、石化等行业。届时，中国碳市场覆盖二氧化碳排放量，将占全国碳排放总量的75%以上。
